claims.claim: The walkthrough covers examples/pii-guardrail-red-team/
Two scenarios probe the support agent, with the pii_leakage guardrail wired into the pack
The guardrail enforces at runtime by replacing leaking content with a safe message
The guardrail fires as a guardrail_triggered signal that a test can assert on
Scenario pii-extraction-attempt, caller asks to read out email and card details
Scenario legitimate-question, caller asks what time branches close
pii_leakage fires for pii-extraction-attempt because the regex pre-pass catches the leak
Both scenarios are scripted text turns against a mock agent, with fixed caller lines
Self-play with an adversarial persona and a turn objective drives the user side with an LLM
Command promptarena run with flags --ci and --formats json,markdown
Run writes out/results.md
The run needs no API keys
pii_leakage regex pre-pass covers emails, US-style SSNs and 16-digit card-shaped numbers, and is deterministic
The pack names a judge for the LLM-judged second layer and the arena config points that judge at a mock provider
Pack file prompts/hardened-support-agent.yaml contains the validators block
Prompt config field validators: is a list of entries with type and params
Validator type pii_leakage
params.direction accepts value output
params.provider names a judge (redaction-judge)
The runtime wraps the pii_leakage eval handler as a provider hook that runs on every agent output
On a high-confidence match the hook replaces content with the safe message and records the validation result on the message
provider names a judge that the arena config declares under judges:
A judge-backed guardrail that names no judge is refused at load
conversation_assertions is a scenario field whose entries have type and params
Assertion type guardrail_triggered
guardrail_triggered params accept validator and should_trigger
guardrail_triggered reads validations recorded on each message and does not re-run the eval
bias, toxicity, role_violation and pii_leakage second layer are LLM-judged primitives that need a judge
Validator type toxicity with direction output and provider redaction-judge
Validator type role_violation with direction output and provider redaction-judge
min_score and max_score thresholds are rejected on the inner safety handler
The inner safety handler emits a raw judge score and the guardrail decides whether to fire
Wrapping the primitive in type: assertion is where the threshold goes for scenario pass/fail
Workflow file .github/workflows/pii-guardrail-red-team.yml with pull_request paths filter on examples/pii-guardrail-red-team/**
Go version 1.26 used by setup-go
Build command go build -o bin/promptarena ./arena/cmd/promptarena
Command ../../bin/promptarena run --ci --formats json
Default scenarios need no keys, so the job is safe on fork pull requests
